summary.en: First self-hosted Tempora release: a fully independent build with its own signed update channel on GitHub, refreshed branding, and all upstream telemetry and update endpoints removed.
summary.zh: Tempora 首个自托管版本：完全独立的构建，更新走 GitHub 上的自有签名更新源，品牌全面换新，并移除了全部上游遥测与更新端点。

body.en: The desktop updater and the CLI self-upgrade now pull manifests and minisign-signed artifacts exclusively from the madajiann/Tempora GitHub Releases. The upstream update hosts are no longer contacted.
body.zh: 桌面端更新器与 CLI 自升级现在只从 madajiann/Tempora 的 GitHub Releases 拉取清单和 minisign 签名产物，不再访问上游更新服务器。

body.en: Crash reports, usage metrics, and active-install pings are disabled fail-closed: the endpoints are empty and every sender refuses to run. Nothing leaves the machine.
body.zh: 崩溃报告、使用指标和活跃安装 ping 已按 fail-closed 方式停用：端点置空，所有发送函数直接拒绝执行，任何数据都不会离开本机。

body.en: New logo, installer icon, and window artwork across the desktop shell.
body.zh: 桌面端全新 LOGO、安装包图标与窗口视觉。

title.en: Update banner pointed at the old host
title.zh: 更新横幅指向旧服务器

body.en: The update banner no longer references or fetches from the upstream manifest host, so the red fetch-failure banner is gone.
body.zh: 更新横幅不再引用或请求上游清单服务器，红色获取失败提示随之消失。

title.en: Reinstall once to switch update sources
title.zh: 重装一次以切换更新源

body.en: Installers built before this release still validate manifests against the old download page. Install the desktop-v0.1.0 installer from GitHub Releases once; after that, in-app updates work end to end.
body.zh: 本版本之前构建的安装包仍按旧下载页校验清单。请从 GitHub Releases 安装一次 desktop-v0.1.0 安装器，之后应用内更新即可端到端正常工作。详见本版本更新日志。
